'''Virtual Modern (ALT)''' — [[Anakin's Lightsaber (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (210_3^) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=アナキンのライトセーバー |printed_game_text=能力値＞3のスカイウォーカーにフォースを消費せずに配備する。キャラクターがいる場所のフォース消耗に＋1。フォースを消費せずに起動する。キャラクターを目標とする。運命数を2枚引く。運命数の合計＞能力値なら、キャラクターに命中し、目標は没収値＝0となる。[[:File:Hoth-Japanese-Anakins-Lightsaber-encyclopedia32-p43-f7f919c08432.jpeg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''アナキン・スカイウォーカーが作ったライトセーバー。ルークに手渡すべく、オビーワンが保管していた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Anakin's Lightsaber '''Card text:''' Deploy without spending Force on a Skywalker with ability > 3. Add 1 to Force drains at the location where the character is. Use without spending Force. Target a character. Draw two destiny. If total destiny > ability, the character is hit and the target's forfeit becomes 0. '''Lore:''' A lightsaber made by Anakin Skywalker. Obi-Wan kept it in order to hand it over to Luke. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese printing states the Force-drain bonus and the free weapon use in separate sentences. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Anakin's Lightsaber]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Artillery Remote (V)]] (1220_108) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=固定兵器用リモート |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して任意の戦士に配備する。同じ惑星上にある自分の固定兵器はいずれも、兵器がある場所に戦士がいなくても起動できる。加えて毎ターン１回、自分の起動フェイズに同じ惑星上の固定兵器を１つ起動することができる。フォースは通常どおりに消費する。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Artillery-Remote-PSA-156433114.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''固定兵器には手動の発射機構がついているが、この装置を追加することによって、離れた場所から操作できるようになる。制御用の信号は暗号化されている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Artillery remote. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any warrior. Any of your artillery weapons on the same planet may fire even if no warrior is present at the weapon's location. Also, once per turn during your control phase, you may fire one artillery weapon on the same planet. Force is spent as usual. '''Lore:''' Artillery weapons have a manual firing mechanism, but adding this device lets them be operated from a remote location. The control signals are encrypted. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Artillery Remote]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Atgar Laser Cannon |side=Light |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Atgar-Laser-Cannon-PSA-152940011.jpg |lead='''Atgar Laser Cannon''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_72o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |deploy=2 |forfeit=2 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Atgar Laser Cannon]] (3_72o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_72o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Atgar Laser Cannon (Errata)]] (3_72) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=アトガー・レーザー砲 |printed_game_text=屋外の惑星位置上に配備する。移動不可。同じ場所にいる自分の戦士が、２フォース消費して同じか隣接する位置にいる目標に対して起動できる。運命数を引く。運命数＋２＞装甲値ならビークルはクラッシュする。運命数＋１＞回避値ならビークルは命中を受ける。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Atgar-Laser-Cannon-PSA-152940011.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''アトガー1.4FD Pタワー、対ビークル砲。改造により、極寒低温の環境でも機能がほとんど低下しない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Atgar laser cannon. '''Card text:''' Deploy on an exterior planet site. Cannot be moved. Your warrior at the same location may fire at a target at the same or an adjacent location, using 2 Force. Draw destiny. A vehicle crashes if destiny +2 > armor. A vehicle is hit if destiny +1 > maneuver. '''Lore:''' Atgar 1.4 FD P-tower, an anti-vehicle cannon. After modification, its performance hardly falls even in extreme cold. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Atgar Laser Cannon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Attack Pattern Delta |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Attack-Pattern-Delta-PSA-156433120.jpg |lead='''Attack Pattern Delta''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_40o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Attack Pattern Delta]] (3_40)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_40o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Attack Pattern Delta (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)]] (1104_2)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Attack Pattern Delta (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (1220_137)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Attack Pattern Delta (V)]] (222_19) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=アタックパターン・デルタ |printed_game_text=位置カードで戦闘が宣言された直後に使用する。そこにいるＴ－４７を一機、先頭機として選ぶ。そのターンの終わりまで、同じ位置にいる他のＴ－４７はそれぞれ戦闘力＋１、加えて耐：損耗を得、武器の目標とならない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Attack-Pattern-Delta-PSA-156433120.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''スカイウォーカー中佐と反乱軍の戦術参謀ベリル・シフォナージが考案したスノースピーダー用の攻撃隊形。１列に並び、敵の砲火を先頭機が引き受けて後続機を守る。'' |translation='''Title:''' Attack Pattern Delta. '''Card text:''' Use immediately after a battle is declared at a location. Choose one T-47 there as the lead. Until the end of that turn, each other T-47 at the same location is power +1, immune to attrition, and may not be targeted by weapons. '''Lore:''' A snowspeeder attack formation devised by Commander Skywalker and Rebel tactician Beryl Chiffonage. They line up in single file, and the lead ship draws enemy fire to protect those behind. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese chooses one T-47 there as the lead; the English identifies your lead T-47. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Attack Pattern Delta]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Bacta Tank |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Bacta-Tank-PSA-148375108.jpg |lead='''Bacta Tank''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_32o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Bacta Tank]] (3_32o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_32o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Bacta Tank (PC Errata)]] (3_32) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊バクタ・タンク |printed_game_text=４フォース消費して場の自分の側に配備する。ロストした直後のドロイド以外のキャラクターを１名、ロストデッキの代わりにここに移すことができる。１度に１名の“患者”を保持する。自分の配備フェイズにＸフォース消費して“患者”を手札に入れることができる。Ｘ＝“患者”の配備コスト。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Bacta-Tank-PSA-148375108.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''昆虫型種族のヴラティックスが何世紀も以前に発明した画期的な医療技術。ゼラチン状の赤いバクタの粒子が合成溶液中に散在しており、治療用バクテリアの媒介物質となる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Bacta Tank. '''Card text:''' Use 4 Force to deploy on your side of the table. A non-droid character just lost may be moved here instead of the Lost Pile. Holds 1 'patient' at a time. During your deploy phase, you may use X Force to take the 'patient' into hand. X = the 'patient's' deploy cost. '''Lore:''' A revolutionary medical technique invented centuries ago by the insectoid Vratix. Gelatinous red bacta particles are suspended in a synthetic solution and serve as a medium for healing bacteria. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Bacta Tank]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher Errata''' - [[Admiral Ozzel (Errata)]] (3_82)
'''Virtual Original''' - [[Admiral Ozzel (V) (Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational)]] (1114_17) (slip 17)
'''Virtual Legacy''' - [[Admiral Ozzel (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (1220_1)
'''Virtual Modern''' - [[Admiral Ozzel (V)]] (213_1) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=オゼル提督 |printed_game_text=自分の大型艦は同じ星系に－1で配備できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。場にベイダーが出ており、相手がオゼルと同じロケーションにリアクションで移動してきたなら、オゼル提督は即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Admiral-Ozzel-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''反乱軍を発見し壊滅させるために皇帝が編成したデス・スコードロンのリーダー。愚鈍で不器用。ダース・ベイダーに失策を露呈したばかりで、もはや失敗は許されない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Admiral Ozzel '''Card text:''' Your capital starships may deploy at -1 to the same system. Adds 2 to the power of the starship he pilots. If Vader is on the table and the opponent moves to Ozzel's location as a react, Admiral Ozzel is immediately lost. '''Lore:''' Leader of the Death Squadron formed by the Emperor to find and destroy the Rebels. Stupid and clumsy. Having just exposed his failure to Darth Vader, he can afford no further failures. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore expresses the English “next-to-last time” joke as allowing no further failures. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Admiral Ozzel]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Advance Preparation |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Used or Lost Interrupt]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Advance-Preparation-SWCA-67665.jpg |lead='''Advance Preparation''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used or Lost Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_43o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=6 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Advance Preparation]] (2_43)

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Advance Preparation (V)]] (1210_144) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=準備万端 |printed_game_text=ユーズド：以下のいずれか1枚のカードを手札から出して、ゲームから除外する。「アタック・ラン」、「邪魔者は片づいたぞ」、「デス・スター：トレンチ」、「反乱軍技師」。代わりに1フォース再使用する。 ロスト：3フォースを使用して、「アタック・ラン」をロストデッキから再使用する。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Advance-Preparation-SWCA-67665.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''相手の動きを素早く察知し、綿密な作戦を立てることによって、反乱軍は作戦行動上の柔軟さを失わず、最善の防御体制で敵を待ち受けることができた。'' |translation='''Title:''' All set. '''Card text:''' USED: Play one of the following cards from hand and place it out of play: Attack Run, You're All Clear Kid, Death Star: Trench, or Rebel technician. Retrieve 1 Force instead. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve Attack Run from the Lost Deck. '''Lore:''' By quickly sensing the opponent's movements and laying careful plans, the Rebellion kept operational flexibility and could wait for the enemy in the best defensive posture. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Advance Preparation]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''PC Errata 2''' — [[Attack Run (PC Errata 2)]] (2_42) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊アタック・ラン |printed_game_text=「デス・スター：トレンチ」に配備する。自分の移動フェイズに、以下の方法でアタック・ランを試みられる： トレンチへの突入：自分の宇宙戦闘機を最大で3機まで「トレンチ」に移動させる（フォースは不要）。ダークサイドは即座に3機までのタイを追跡に向かわせられる（フォースは不要）。 編隊を組む：宇宙戦闘機のうち1機を先頭機（「プロトン魚雷」*が必要）に指定し、残りがいるなら編隊僚機とする。「ターボレーザー砲塔」および兵器を配備しているタイは、この時点で反乱軍（ライトサイド）の宇宙戦闘機に向けて武器の使用を行う（最初は編隊僚機を狙い、それが全滅してから先頭機を攻撃する）。命中した宇宙戦闘機は即座にロストする。 発射したぞ！：運命数を2つ引く。 逃げろ、引き上げだ：宇宙戦闘機はすべて「デス・スター」星系カード上に移動する（フォースは不要）。 もし、（運命数の合計＋X＋Y－Z）＞15なら、デス・スターは“壊滅”する。 X＝先頭機パイロットの能力値。ただし「照準コンピュータ」が配備されている場合には3。 Y＝反乱軍の基地（ヤヴィン4またはホス）のうち最大のものにある位置カードの合計数。 Z＝その位置にいるタイのパイロットのうち最も能力値の高いものの値。 *アタック・ラン中には「オーバーロード」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Attack-Run-SWCA-67653.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |translation='''Title:''' Attack Run. '''Card text:''' Deploy on Death Star: Trench. During your move phase, you may attempt an Attack Run as follows: Enter the trench: Move up to 3 of your starfighters to the Trench (no Force). The Dark Side may immediately send up to 3 TIEs in pursuit (no Force). Form a squadron: Designate 1 starfighter as the lead (Proton Torpedoes* required); remaining starfighters, if any, are wingmen. Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons now fire at Rebel (Light Side) starfighters (wingmen first, then the lead after those are wiped out). Hit starfighters are immediately lost. It's away!: Draw two destiny. Run, pull up: All starfighters move to the Death Star system card (no Force). If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) > 15, the Death Star is "devastated." X = ability of the lead pilot, or 3 if Targeting Computer is deployed. Y = total location cards at the largest Rebel base (Yavin 4 or Hoth). Z = the highest ability among TIE pilots at that location. *During Attack Run, not affected by Overload. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese 壊滅 is devastated; the English is blown away. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Attack Run]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Title'''
Luke Skywalker, Lieutenant Colonel
'''Lore'''
Hero of the Battle of Yavin. Over these three years, he gained experience as a soldier of the Alliance, and his current rank is lieutenant colonel. At the Battle of Hoth, he served as the leader of Echo Base's flight squadron.
'''Game text'''
May deploy only on Hoth, but may move anywhere afterward. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Rogue 1, adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3. All other Rogue Squadron pilots and gunners at the same Hoth location have forfeit +1.
The Japanese title and lore use 中佐, a rank term translated as lieutenant colonel or, in naval usage, commander; the English printing uses Commander. The Japanese game text explicitly says "if piloting Rogue 1"; the English face says "On Rogue 1". Both printed faces give the +3 power bonus to a starship he pilots. The Japanese lore describes three years of military experience and his current rank, rather than the English sentence about promotion in his third year. The final Japanese sentence uses 位置 (location), whereas the original English face specifies a "site".[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_7o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ドイック・ナッツ |printed_game_text=同じ位置カード上にいる他のミュージシャン1名につき、双方のプレイヤーとも、この位置での戦闘で運命数を引くために必要な能力値が1多くなる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Doikk-Nats-PSA-164793237.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ビス男性のミュージシャン。フィグリン・ダンのバンドでフィッツ（曲名ドアリニアン・ベシュニケル）を演奏する。知的生命体、なかでも人間嫌いが激しく、ドロイドと一緒に働く方が性に合う。'' |translation='''Title:''' Doikk Na'ts. He strongly dislikes sentients, especially humans, and prefers working with droids. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Doikk Na'ts]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian (V)]] (200_10) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊デレク・“ホビー”・キルヴィアン |printed_game_text=ビッグズと同じ位置にいるなら戦闘力＋２。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２（スター・デストロイヤーが同じ場所にいるなら３）を加える。ローグ４を操縦するなら回避値に２を加える。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Derek-Hobbie-Klivian-PSA-164089327.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ビッグズ・ダークライターと共に帝国軍から脱走してきた。輸送船ランド・エクリプティックで反乱を起こしたエクリプティック・イヴエイダーズの一員。ホスの戦いではルークの編隊僚機をつとめた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Derek "Hobbie" Klivian. '''Card text:''' Power +2 when at the same location as Biggs. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots (3 if a Star Destroyer is at the same location). Adds 2 to maneuver if he pilots Rogue 4. '''Lore:''' He defected from the Empire with Biggs Darklighter. A member of the Ecliptic Evaders, who mutinied aboard the transport Rand Ecliptic. At the Battle of Hoth he flew as Luke's wingman. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. The creature has its arm cut off (treated as if Severed Arm is on it) and, each time ferocity is calculated, draws one destiny and subtracts that amount. Not affected by Control. '''Lore:''' Luke struck the arm off in a split second. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says Luke struck the arm off; the English is a pun on 'out of arm's way'. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Disarming Creature]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Card text:''' Under “nighttime conditions,” you may use 1 Force to “hide” from a battle (does not participate). '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_51o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=なんだか嫌な予感がする |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：このターンに相手が4人以上のキャラクターを同じ位置に配備した場合に使用する。それらのキャラクターは全員、このターンの間は戦闘を行えない。2：相手が戦闘に対して“リアクション”を行った直後に使用する。その戦闘をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-I-Have-A-Very-Bad-Feeling-About-This-PSA-173318901.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「あの小型機、小さな月に向かってるよ」「月ではない。あれは宇宙ステーションだ」オビ＝ワンの言葉を聞いてルークは胸騒ぎを覚えた。'' |translation='''Title:''' I have a somehow unpleasant premonition. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Use if the opponent deployed 4 or more characters to the same location this turn. Those characters may not battle for the rest of this turn. 2: Use immediately after the opponent “reacts” to a battle. Cancel that battle. '''Lore:''' “That small craft is heading for a small moon.” “That is not a moon. It is a space station.” Hearing Obi-Wan's words, Luke felt a pang of unease. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is なんだか嫌な予感がする. The Japanese numbers the two options. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. You passionate one. Title: R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) Lore:
A small-bodied droid brimming with energy, loyal to his master and brave. A Rebel spy who is strong in adversity. Though 3PO derided him as a “cold-hearted philosopher,” his personality is rather the opposite. He is somewhat restless and sometimes acts unexpectedly.
Card text:
Adds +2 to the power, maneuver and hyperspeed of the starfighter he is aboard (+3 if Red 5). When he is at a place with an access link and the opponent draws destiny, activate 1 Force if it is 1–3. If it is 4–6, draw the top card of the Reserve Deck and add it to your hand.
=== Comparison with the English printing === The Japanese lore says that 3PO derided R2-D2 as a “cold-hearted philosopher”; the English face instead calls R2-D2 the “Incorrigible counterpart of a mindless philosopher.” The Japanese game text uses アクセス・リンク (access link) for the English Scomp link and states the two results directly, without words corresponding to the English “you may.” It expressly adds the drawn Reserve Deck card to the hand. The printed numerical statistics match the inspected English face. Neither inspected face prints a Nav Computer symbol; a later rule-derived capability must not be presented as a printed icon.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. The comparison uses the [[:File:ANH-L-r2d2.gif|original English card face]]. |see_also=* [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)|English counterpart]] * [[A New Hope (Japanese)#Card list|Japanese A New Hope card list]] * [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese|Japanese printings]] |see_also_heading=See also |has_refs=1 |extra_sections=

Statistics

The printed values and symbols are shown above. The face prints one Droid symbol and the subtype 操縦ドロイド (astromech droid). It has no printed ability number and no printed Nav Computer, Pilot or Warrior symbol. Its lore identifies a Rebel spy.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 42 (Japanese card face), pp. 101–102 (checklist). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. Base landspeed is 1 under the character movement rule; this is a rule-derived value, not a printed statistic.[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0#Landspeed|Rulebook 2.0, Landspeed]]: “Characters have landspeed of 1.” The 1998 Glossary states that astromech droids provide nav computers. This is a rule-derived capability, separate from the absence of a printed Nav Computer symbol on this face.[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary (1998)]], pp. 15 and 94, “astromech” and “nav computer icon”. The same Glossary gives droids no ability and gives droids without armor a defense value of zero.[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary (1998)]], p. 52, “droid”. |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_107o)

If the spy's identity is revealed, the above card rules are canceled, and the Light Side may use this droid as if stolen. '''Lore:''' This protocol droid served Alderaan's diplomatic corps. The Empire altered its programming and used it for espionage. The droid became an Imperial spy without even knowing it. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses the Light Side character template. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[URoRRuR'R'R (V)]] (1210_25) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウ |printed_game_text=タトゥイーンにしか配備できないが、そこからなら好きなところへ移動できる。他のタスケン・レイダーと同じ位置にいるなら、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、1枚引ける。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-URoRRuRRR-PSA-93071765.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''タスケン・レイダー部族のリーダー。機械を恐れない。優れた狩人にして銃の名手。水を奪いにモイスチャー・ファームを襲撃する。不用心な旅行者を求めてジャンドランドの荒地を徘徊する。'' |translation='''Title:''' URoRRuR'R'R. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face adds that after deploying on Tatooine he may move anywhere. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[URoRRuR'R'R]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Card text:''' If Vader is on table, play just after the opponent declares a battle. Target an opponent's leader in that battle with destiny less than 6. If the opponent did not win, the target's forfeit becomes 0 and it is immediately lost. If it is Ozzel, it becomes an excluded card. '''Lore:''' Lord Vader. The fleet has left lightspeed, and from now... whoa... ugh... gueh. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is a translated movie line, not a literal English title. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[You Have Failed Me For The Last Time]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103.
